transcript.answer: Lore's agent pods run on the external floor, in the `floor` namespace. The external floor has its own controller and its own cluster agent, and it installs the ai-agent-subsystem controller itself (ADR-049). Lore does not run them. Its own `ai-agents` controller, its cluster agent and the satellite chart were removed on 2026-10-02, and `apps/floor` and `apps/cluster-agent` were deleted. Lore therefore holds no Kubernetes client to start agent pods, and no Lore process dispatches them. Before that removal, the Floor created Agent CRs directly. Then ADR-024's 2026-08-24 amendment moved cluster authority into a per-cluster `apps/cluster-agent`, the only process holding a Kubernetes client, which the Floor and lore-api reached over HTTP. That arrangement no longer exists.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly says the pods run on the external floor and that Lore holds no Kubernetes client, but it omits that Lore reaches the floor only through @re-cinq/floor-client (FLOOR_API_URL).
